summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited filed a Form 6-K to disclose receipt of a formal notification from Van Eck Associate Corporation that it acquired an aggregate beneficial interest of 5.0167% of Harmony's total issued ordinary shares. This filing is a routine regulatory notification made under section 122(3)(b) of the South African Companies Act, Regulation 121(2)(b), and JSE Listing Requirements. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is underway by Harmony itself. The filing merely reports a third-party's shareholding crossing a disclosure threshold and compliance with the Takeover Regulation Panel notice requirement. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions to analyze; the event is informational only, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
